newsitem.title: SPAIN: March Group sells 6.5 pct of Gines Navarro.
newsitem.headline: March Group sells 6.5 pct of Gines Navarro.

text.p: Spain's March group told Reuters on Tuesday it had sold a 6.5 percent stake in Gines Navarro to institutional investors for just under 3.0 billion pesetas.
The investment group said the price per share was 3,100 pesetas in a deal brokered AB Asesores on Monday.
The March group, which owns Gines Navarro, said the sale aimed to increase liquidity of the stock ahead of Gines Navarro's merger with OCP Construcciones.
The two building firms announced at the beginning of June that they would merge in the next six months.

"The (March stake) sale seeks to boost the stock's liquidity in the light of the merger with OCP so that around 50 percent of the new company's capital will be traded in the market," a March spokesman said.
After the merger, the March group will hold 23 percent of the new company while OCP owners Florentino Perez and Mercapital will hold 27 percent.
